title: Josh and Chuck's 2014 Christmas Extravaganza!
summary: Josh and Chuck's 2014 Christmas special covers the movie A Christmas Story (Bob Clark, Jean Shepherd stories, Cleveland filming, Higbee's, TBS marathon, trivia about Darren McGavin and the leg lamp), a mulled wine recipe and its history with Dickens, the USPS Operation Santa letters to Santa, the Christmas Pants prank between Larry Kunkle and Roy Collette, the Xmas abbreviation and the Greek letter chi, and a reading of L. Frank Baum's story "When the World Grew Old" from The Life and Adventures of Santa Claus.
topics: Life and Adventures of Santa Claus

entities.name: The Life and Adventures of Santa Claus

segments.title: Opening banter and Christmas mood
segments.summary: Hosts welcome listeners to the Christmas episode, joke about the decorations and mood, and introduce the planned topics, including A Christmas Story.

segments.title: Origins of A Christmas Story
segments.summary: Bob Clark discovers Jean Shepherd's radio stories, makes B movies including Black Christmas, then makes Porky's, which funds A Christmas Story. The film is shot in Cleveland, using Higbee's department store, and is a moderate box office success before cable and TBS marathons make it a hit.

segments.title: A Christmas Story trivia and filming locations
segments.summary: Facts about the cast and crew: Jack Nicholson was once offered the father role, Darren McGavin's role, Jean Shepherd's narration and cameo, Bob Clark's cameo, Grover Dill later in Better Off Dead, the leg lamp designed by Ruben Freed, the December 1940 setting, and filming in Toronto and Cleveland's Christmas Story House.

segments.title: Mulled wine history and recipe
segments.summary: Hosts discuss mulled wine's origins, Dickens's association with it, the hosts' tastes, and a basic recipe with dry red wine, brandy, citrus, honey and spices, heated slowly without boiling. They mention a Dickens pub in Worth that microwaves it and a line from Oliver Twist.

segments.title: Letters to Santa and Operation Santa
segments.summary: Old-timey children's letters to Santa are discussed. The USPS began answering them around 1912 under Postmaster General Frank Hitchcock, and volunteers can respond through Operation Santa at participating post offices after filling out forms. Canada's Santa postal code H0H 0H0 is mentioned.

segments.title: The Christmas Pants prank
segments.summary: Larry Kunkle and Roy Collette trade a pair of Moleskin pants for over twenty years in escalating practical jokes, including a pipe, a compacted Gremlin, a concrete rocket, a concrete tire, welded generators, a giant concrete Rubik's cube, and finally a glass encasement that shattered, leaving the pants as ashes in an urn.

segments.title: Xmas abbreviation and the Greek letter chi
segments.summary: The hosts explain that X in Xmas comes from the Greek letter chi, an abbreviation for Christ used for centuries, so Christmas still contains Christ. The Straight Dope is credited.

segments.title: Reading from L. Frank Baum's Santa Claus story
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh introduce L. Frank Baum's The Life and Adventures of Santa Claus and read the chapter 'When the World Grew Old', in which the gods grant Santa immortality and he continues making toys for children as the world grows.
topics: Life and Adventures of Santa Claus

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Hosts wish listeners a merry Christmas and happy holidays and say goodbye.
